derivedBy: hand, from the stated dimensions in bench.design.md; never regenerated from napkin's output

overall.derivation: The extreme corners of every box, worked out in inches then x1024.

boxes.name: Top
boxes.derivation: Lies flat, 42" across X, 12" up Y, 1 1/2" thick, its underside at 17" (the legs' height). Occupies z 17..18 1/2.

boxes.name: Leg, south-west
boxes.derivation: Inset 2" from the top's west and south edges; 3 1/2" square; 17" tall (its depth). Occupies x 2..5 1/2, y 2..5 1/2.

boxes.name: Leg, south-east
boxes.derivation: Its east face is 2" in from the top's east edge at 42 - 2 = 40", so its west face is 40 - 3 1/2 = 36 1/2". Occupies x 36 1/2..40, y 2..5 1/2.

boxes.name: Leg, north-west
boxes.derivation: Its north face is 2" in from the top's north edge at 12 - 2 = 10", so its south face is 10 - 3 1/2 = 6 1/2". Occupies x 2..5 1/2, y 6 1/2..10.

boxes.name: Leg, north-east
boxes.derivation: The east x of the south-east leg with the south y of the north-west leg. Occupies x 36 1/2..40, y 6 1/2..10.

boxes.name: Rail
boxes.derivation: ONE box that stands for TWO pieces (the front and back rails are cut alike): it runs between the south legs from x 5 1/2 to 36 1/2 = 31", 3/4" thick up Y, 3" tall (its depth), its upper edge flush with the top's underside at 17", so it starts at z 14.

cutList.label: Rail
cutList.derivation: On edge: length across X = 31" = 31744, thickness up Y = 3/4" = 768, width its depth 3" = 3072. It is ONE box with quantity 2, so the row's quantity is 2 while its members list holds the one box: quantities are summed, boxes are not counted. Text: 31 = 2 x 12 + 7 -> 2'-7".

cutList.label: Leg
cutList.derivation: Stands up: 3 1/2" square (3584) in plan, length its depth, 17" = 17408. Four boxes, one row of 4. Text: 17 = 1 x 12 + 5 -> 1'-5". Label: the four names share "Leg, " -> "Leg". The design says the legs were drawn once, duplicated, and mirrored; the file only holds the four boxes.

cutListCsv: Cut list: finished sizes before saw kerf and joinery allowance.
